The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d94e973e689e60b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 28-29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let W(z) = cV (z) + χ(z), c > 0, χ ∈ C∞ c ((−∞, −1)), 28 and suppose that W ≥ 0, W′ ≤ 0, and W′′ ≥ 0 distributionally. For every fixed β > 0, the terminal u = −βW has a concave row functional on all profiles with fixed diagonal Q ∈ [1/2, 2]. The derivative formula (2.6), continuity of Dq in L1, and the uniform tangent-cap limits hold for this terminal. In particular, the Gaussian interpolation upper bound derived for smooth concave caps applies to −βW after removal of the cap.
